cohort: The cohort consisted of infants born at >= 35 weeks' gestation with total serum bilirubin levels close to the phototherapy threshold, identified from 16 Kaiser Permanente Northern California hospitals between 2013-2017.
finding: After adjusting for confounders, birth hospitalization phototherapy did not adversely affect exclusive breastmilk feeding and showed a slightly positive association with any breastmilk feeding at 2 months.
